title: Show HN: Uruky (EU-based Kagi alternative) now has Image Search and URL Rewrites
summary: Uruky is an EU-based privacy-focused search engine alternative to Kagi that has launched new features including image search and URL rewrites, offering a unique 2-hour free trial through a proof-of-work captcha system when users top up their account.
problem_solved: Provides a privacy-respecting alternative to mainstream search engines with EU jurisdiction for users concerned about data collection.
why_valuable: Offers EU-based search with strong privacy guarantees, no tracking, and innovative trial model using proof-of-work, with plans to move to permissive source-available licensing.
